name: Cannabis cultivation facility
summary: Indoor licensed cultivation priced per SF of gross building area. MEP dominates: HVAC/dehumidification and electrical service plus lighting are each about 20% of cost, and MEP overall ≈ 50–60%. Published all-in figures run $175–550/SF; watch the denominator (canopy is only 55–70% of gross area) and whether the figure is a warehouse conversion or ground-up. Sources are contractor/consultant statements in trade press (2017–2026), so confidence is medium.

typicalSize.method: e2: facilities 'range in size from 3,000 sf to 1,000,000 sf or more'; e1 cost guide is framed around 20,000+ SF operations. Mid 30,000 SF ≈ mid-tier state license; low 10,000 SF small/craft tier; high 150,000 SF large multi-state-operator facility.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Single-story industrial building on ~0.28–0.50 FAR site (truck court, parking, security setbacks, stormwater): 43,560 × 0.28–0.50.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Light-industrial staffing; ≈1 space per 1,000 SF (0.5–1.5 per 1,000).

perPrimaryUnit.method: e1 (2026) total indoor buildout $250–550/SF of gross building area including soft costs at 8–12% of hard → ÷ 1.10 = $227–500 hard; component ranges in e1 (HVAC $30–100, electrical $30–65, security $5–15, plumbing/fire $8–18 per GBA SF; lighting $25–60 and racking $10–45 per canopy SF) sum to ~$135–370/SF before shell, so the totals are consistent with a complete facility. e2 (2019) $208–425/SF; $240/SF single-level renovation; $300–320/SF multi-level. e3 (2017, MA) $175–200/SF conversion buildout with ~$100/SF MEP. Mid $350 = e1 midpoint ($400) less soft (≈$364), rounded down to reflect older/conversion evidence (e2, e3). Low $225 = e1 low after soft ≈ e2 low; high $500 = e1 high after soft. Expressed in 2026$ (e1); e2/e3 are older (2017/2019) and used as cross-checks only.

scope.notes: Ground-up or full-gut facility: shell, insulated-panel grow rooms, HVAC/dehumidification, electrical service and distribution, LED grow lighting, benching/racking, fertigation, odor control, security/surveillance, fire protection, sitework; GC/OH&P. Excludes land/building acquisition, licensing fees, harvest/processing FF&E, off-site utility upgrades.

qualityTiers.method: Economy ≈ low/mid ($225/$350, conversion with fixed benches); premium ≈ multi-tier vertical racking and full HVACD redundancy; luxury ≈ high/mid ($500/$350) GMP/EU-GMP-grade.

systemSplit.method: Built on the $350/SF mid using e1 component midpoints (canopy = 60% of GBA): 23 = HVACD $65 + odor $5.5; 26 = electrical $47.5 + lighting $42.5×0.6; 22 = fertigation $7.5×0.6 + plumbing $8; 21 = fire protection $5; 13 = insulated metal panel rooms ≈ $18.75/GBA SF; 09 = flooring $13; 11 = racking/benching $27.5×0.6; 28 = security $10. Shell/site/GC (not itemized in e1) assumed: 01 $28, 03 $22, 05 $25, 07 $18, 08 $6, 31/32/33 $12; 25 = remaining $19.75 for environmental/BMS controls (e1 notes HVAC install and controls add 40–60% to equipment). Shell split is an assumption (verify).

cost.method: e1 HVAC/HVACD $30–$100/SF of gross building area ($50–150 per canopy SF); mid = midpoint.

cost.method: Placeholder: indoor grows draw ~50–100 W/SF; a 30,000 SF facility needs ~2–3 MW of service. Utility contribution varies widely. Verify with the utility.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Harvest, drying/curing, trimming, packaging and lab equipment plus office/break FF&E; e1 excludes FF&E for non-cultivation areas. Assumed $5–25/SF of gross area. Verify.

pctOfHard.method: e1 soft costs '8–12% of hard construction cost' ($15–40/SF) → low/mid. High 20% for MEP-heavy custom design, cannabis consultants, and longer entitlement/zoning processes. State license application/fees excluded (vary from <$10k to >$1M by state).

softCosts.notes: Licensing fees, application costs and pre-opening operating capital are not included.

design.method: MEP-intensive, owner-driven cultivation design; higher than typical industrial.

hard.method: Electrical service and HVACD equipment lead times/pricing risk.

perPrimaryUnit.method: e3 $175/SF conversion buildout (2017) is the floor; e1 page header cites up to $650/SF all-in for 2026.

source.title: 2026 Cost Guide: Indoor Cannabis Cultivation Facility Buildout — Total All-In Costs for 20,000+ SF Operations

evidence.quote: Total Indoor Cannabis Facility Buildout: $250 – $550 per square foot (gross building area). ... Soft costs: 8–12% of hard construction cost. HVAC/HVACD $30–$100/SF (GBA); Lighting $25–$60/SF (canopy); Electrical $30–$65/SF (GBA); Security $5–$15/SF (GBA).
evidence.scopeNotes: Consultant cost guide (published March 1, 2026); all-in incl. soft costs; excludes real estate, licensing, operating capital and non-cultivation FF&E. Page header separately says $250 to $650/SF.

source.title: The coming bonanza in marijuana facilities

evidence.quote: Cultivation facilities can range in size from 3,000 sf to 1,000,000 sf or more ... come in anywhere from $208/sf to $425/sf ... will run $240/sf for a single-level cultivation facility with fixed benching ... these can cost $300–320/sf
evidence.scopeNotes: Designer/contractor quotes (Jan 2019); $240 = renovation of existing building; $300–320 = multi-level vertical canopy. Hard vs soft scope not stated.

source.title: Construction tips for marijuana cultivation facilities

evidence.quote: Vantage Builders has seen projects typically fall in the $175-$200 per square foot range for buildout, with close to $100 per square foot of that cost for the MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) systems.
evidence.scopeNotes: Contractor buildout (likely interior conversion of existing building), Feb 2017; MEP ≈ 50–57% of cost.

openQuestions: No public bid tab or cost-consultant (RLB/Cumming) model for cannabis cultivation found; the default rests on one 2026 consultant guide plus older trade-press quotes.
